verdicts.reason: Both candidates are almost the same banner-shaped strip dropped into a square. The building photo stays a thin band with nothing beside it on the right, the bottom ~40% of the canvas is dead white, and the headline floats in the top third with nothing to balance it, so the format was never really re-laid out. B pushes the headline closer to the right edge (about 30px of margin against A's roughly 45px), which is slightly more cramped, so A edges it.
